votes.motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Brooke Christensen to suspend the rules in order to take action on Ordinance 21-20

A motion was made by Monica Zoltanski, seconded by Zach Robinson to adopt Ordinance #21-20, an ordinance amending Title 20, Chapter 6 - Sec. 4, "Discharge of Fireworks" of the Sandy City Code by updating Exhibit "B" with a new map depicting prohibited areas for the discharge of fireworks within Sandy City (all areas east of 1300 East) and also providing a saving clause and an effective date for the ordinance
